method.network_scope: Actual captured course and video persisted metadata GETs; no returned URL was followed.
method.course_fields: Replacement fields, public author slug/display name, title/release/update metadata, provided repository/Codespace/external-provider/presentation fields, exercise-file offer metadata, and course-description hyperlinks/literal HTTP(S) URLs.
method.lesson_fields: Structured hyperlink attributes and literal HTTP(S) URLs extracted privately from description text; description text and URL values are excluded from sanitized reports. Extracted strings and structured hyperlinks are candidates, not independently validated course assets.
method.cached_scope: Thirty-three already-observed default-video descriptions retain their original per-course observation times and page-hash provenance. They are not counted as fresh requests.
method.url_detection_limit: Plain-text detection checks literal valid HTTP(S) URLs only. Unstructured bare domains, obfuscated links, non-HTTP plain-text schemes, spoken links, and links inside unqueried course content are outside that detection method. Structured hyperlink metadata may retain non-HTTP schemes in coarse invalid_or_non_http category counts; these are not HTTP URL candidates, and accessibility and relevance remain unverified.
method.relationship_limit: The captured schema exposes replacement fields but no explicit original-audio, translation-family, or version-family fields. Absence from the observed schema does not prove such relationships do not exist elsewhere.

relationship_comparison.method: All fixed-inventory course pairs compared by exact lesson IDs, declared public author slugs, and deterministic title/version-label matching; no semantic translation inference.

normalized_title_candidate_groups.meaning: A deterministic title grouping, including source-localized titles; not a declared translation, version family, replacement, or compatibility relationship.

limits: Titles can be localized by the source and are not independent original-language evidence.
Shared authors, release dates, similar titles, and title version labels do not establish translation, product-family membership, successor status, equivalence, compatibility, or shared asset bytes.

structural_review_clues.method: Independent offline recomputation from the fixed, dated TOC lesson-title metadata and advertised archive filenames/byte sizes; no lesson bodies, semantic translation, or asset-byte comparison.

parameters.normalization: Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks, lowercase, collapse punctuation/symbols to spaces; no number/version stripping, stemming, synonym mapping or translation.

parameters.archive_comparison: Exact advertised archive filename plus byte-size metadata for archive extensions zip/7z/rar/tar/gz/bz2/xz; no downloaded-byte comparison.

limits: Matching substantive title metadata and preserved order are review clues only; they do not declare a translation, version family, successor, equivalent content, or compatible assets.
Exact lexical matching can miss translated or substantially renamed lessons. Generic-title exclusions are a stated dictionary, not an exhaustive semantic filter.
Zero advertised archive filename/size overlaps does not establish unequal bytes or disprove shared source assets.
TOC and archive comparisons use the recorded source capture dates; fresh course checks do not relabel those TOCs as newly observed.
